question: Calculate the average revenue growth of all five companies.
generated_sql: SELECT "company_name", AVG("revenue_growth") AS "average_revenue_growth" FROM (SELECT "company_name", "fiscal_year", "metric_value", LAG("metric_value") OVER (PARTITION BY "company_name" ORDER BY "fiscal_year") AS "previous_revenue", CASE WHEN LAG("metric_value") OVER (PARTITION BY "company_name" ORDER BY "fiscal_year") IS NOT NULL THEN (("metric_value" - LAG("metric_value") OVER (PARTITION BY "company_name" ORDER BY "fiscal_year")) / LAG("metric_value") OVER (PARTITION BY "company_name" ORDER BY "fiscal_year")) * 100 ELSE NULL END AS "revenue_growth" FROM analytics.company_financial_metrics WHERE "metric_name" = 'revenue' AND "fiscal_period" = 'FY' AND "fiscal_year" BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025) AS "growth_calc" WHERE "revenue_growth" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "company_name";
